core_problem_solved: To provide high-level data binding (object mapping) functionality for converting between Java objects and JSON, for the Jackson 1.x series.
key_features: The original `ObjectMapper` class for data binding in Jackson 1.x.
Serialization (Java to JSON) and deserialization (JSON to Java).
era_and_niche: The legacy data-binding module for the Jackson 1.x series. It was the main entry point for most developers using Jackson in its early, formative years.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **obsolete**. The entire Jackson project moved from Codehaus to the FasterXML organization and was rewritten as Jackson 2.x. The direct modern successor is **`com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind`**.
